_comment: MENU-1 seed allowlist (tests/test_channel_menus_come_from_registry.py) - every entry is a QMenu( construction site outside streamselect/gui/channel_menu.py that is NOT channel-shaped (a section header, a config-only aggregate, a prefix/category axis, a filter dropdown, a picker for something other than a channel row) and so stays hand-rolled. Shrink-only: a site that migrates onto the channel_menu.py registry must be REMOVED here, never left (test_the_allowlist_only_shrinks fails the suite if it is). Format: file::qualified_function (Class.method inside a class, bare function name at module level).

sites.reason: section-level 'Clear Unavailable' menu on empty-space/header right-click - not channel-shaped.
prefix-level 'Add to Global Exclusions' chip menu - not channel-shaped.
prefix/category-level filtered-variant chip menu (unhide category / remove filter / manage exclusions) - not channel-shaped.
DETAILS-3c 'label x-N' chip picker - a flat list of which identical-label copy to show, not a channel-verb menu.
download-id-keyed row menu, not a ChannelDB row - own docstring: 'not the channel registry'.
recording-id-keyed row menu, not a ChannelDB row - own docstring: 'not the channel registry'.
episode-grain series-tree menu - episodes are not ChannelDB rows; own comment: 'that registry is ChannelDB-only today'.
collection-level chip menu (exclude/include a source's collection, manage exclusions) - a collection axis, the sibling of _show_filtered_chip_menu, not channel-shaped.
the exclude_collection action's own flat picker of a title's collections - like the show_versions picker, not a channel-verb menu itself.
the show_versions action's own flat picker of (quality, language, source) content_key siblings - not a channel-verb menu itself.
multi-select filter dropdown (language/region/etc. checkboxes) - not channel-shaped.
filter-chip solo/exclude-globally menu on a facet value - not channel-shaped.
trailer playback-source picker (inline vs YouTube) - not channel-shaped.
section-header 'Hide section / Sidebar settings…' menu, shared by every sidebar section - not channel-shaped.
section-level ⋯ overflow menu (refresh, clear history, etc.) - not channel-shaped.
playback settings, tracks and queue for the window behind the header readout - no channel row involved.
Sports event-alert rules (this event / either team / whenever they meet) - event-shaped, not channel-shaped.
hide a COLLECTION from one league's games (the eye on a game's channel row) - league/collection axis, not a channel.

a game's channel row: prefer/hide for this league, report no picture / not this game - keyed on the collection and the game. Its one channel-level action (Hide this channel everywhere) should come from the registry: ledger D75.
game card menu (Mark as finished; no picture / not this game on the card's own channel, the same reports as its channel rows) - game-shaped, not channel-shaped.
